name: EPIC 206426057
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 8.2 solar radii and 1.09 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 206426057 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.161023 (16th-84th percentiles 7.776372-8.56525), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 206426057 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2885.3125 (16th-84th percentiles 2761.914062-3003.203125), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 2,885 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 1.09 solar masses and 8.2 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,635 K at its surface.
